steps.text: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
Just yourself, I've got the rest
You didn't have to do everything
It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
I know, I just wanted to help
You can help me eat it
That part I'm very qualified for 😌
Good morning, by the way
Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
Did you sleep okay?
Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
How about you?
Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
I'll survive
What's on the menu tonight?
Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
I can manage that
I got the lemonade you like too
You remembered?
You always look for it when you're here
That's really sweet ❤️
I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
I'm not going to argue with dessert
Excellent, one decision made without a fight
Still around six?
Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
I'll be here
I'm glad we're doing this tonight
Me too
I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
You're not ready yet?
Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
A few minutes later, before she leaves...
There, both earrings and everything 😊
You look lovely
Thank you ❤️
Have a good day
You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
No promises about the crispy edges
Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
Love you, see you tonight
Love you too
